kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_trait.tool: A machine's Power Grid output source.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_trait.desc: The generic Trait node returns any trait; this narrows it to the Power Grid output source so the Power Grid nodes can read it.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_trait.in.t: The trait, from Machine Trait. Leave empty to look it up by name.
The trait name shown in the machine editor, used when no trait is wired.
The trait, or nothing if this machine has no Power Grid output.
Whether the machine has a Power Grid output trait.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.toolt: What the Power Grid source is delivering right now, plus its settings and definition limits.
Power, voltage, current and source resistance are live values: they include the running recipe output or the definition's continuous fallback, and the maximum-current cap. The setting outputs show the effective values after any runtime override.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.in.tr: The Power Grid output trait, from Power Grid Trait.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.w: Whether the host's recipe logic is currently working.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.s: The source's internal resistance at the current operating point, in ohms.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.v: The effective voltage setting after any runtime override, in volts.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.c: The effective current limit after any runtime override, in amperes.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.p: The effective power target after any runtime override, in watts.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.v: Whether the voltage is currently overridden at runtime.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.c: Whether the current limit is currently overridden at runtime.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.p: Whether the power target is currently overridden at runtime.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.t: How many terminals the definition exposes.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.m: The definition's current cap, in amperes.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.c: The definition's continuous fallback power, in watts.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_output_info.out.r: The definition's configured voltage, in volts.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_voltage.toolt: Override this machine's Power Grid output voltage, or clear the override.
The override is per machine, persisted, and applied immediately. With no power behind it the source presents an open-circuit voltage.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_voltage.in.tr: The Power Grid output trait, from Power Grid Trait.
The trait name to use when no trait is wired.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_voltage.in.vo: Voltage to apply, in volts. Must be positive.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_voltage.in.cl: Clear the voltage override instead of setting it.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_current.toolt: Override this machine's Power Grid current limit, or clear the override.
The limit caps power / voltage; it does not force current. Set it to 0 to switch the source off.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_current.in.tr: The Power Grid output trait, from Power Grid Trait.
The trait name to use when no trait is wired.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_current.in.cu: Current limit to apply, in amperes. Must be non-negative.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_current.in.cl: Clear the current override instead of setting it.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_power.tooltip: Override this machine's Power Grid target output power, or clear the override.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_power.desc.1: The target is still clamped to voltage * current limit; raise those to raise the ceiling.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_power.in.trai: The Power Grid output trait, from Power Grid Trait.
The trait name to use when no trait is wired.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_power.in.powe: Target power to apply, in watts. Must be non-negative.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_set_power.in.clea: Clear the power override instead of setting it.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_clear_overrides.t: Drop all Power Grid output overrides, returning the source to its recipe/definition behaviour.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_clear_overrides.d: Clears voltage, current limit and power in one action.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_clear_overrides.i: The Power Grid output trait, from Power Grid Trait.
The trait name to use when no trait is wired.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_energy_info.toolt: The two numbers inside a Power Grid recipe output.
Current is derived from power and voltage; it is not stored on the payload.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_energy_info.in.en: The payload, from Content Value on powergrid_energy.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_energy_info.out.c: Power divided by voltage, in amperes.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_energy_of.tooltip: A Power Grid recipe payload, to feed Content Of.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_energy_of.desc.1: An invalid power or voltage produces no payload instead of failing the graph.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_energy_of.in.powe: Power, in watts. Must be non-negative.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_energy_of.in.volt: Voltage, in volts. Must be positive.
kg.node.mbd2_powergrid_energy_of.out.ene: The recipe payload, or nothing when the inputs are invalid.
